traditional: 幫 A 同 B 和好返
jyutping: bong1 A tung4 B wo4 hou2 faan1

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken way to get two people who have quarrelled to make up again.

examples.english: I’ll help the two of them reconcile first; constantly arguing isn’t a solution.
examples.traditional: 我幫佢哋兩個和好返先，成日鬧交都唔係辦法。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 bong1 keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 wo4 hou2 faan1 sin1 seng4 jat6 naau6 gaau1 dou1 m4 hai6 baan6 faat3
